name: VOX Documentary
description: A VOX-style editorial documentary with NO video model, from the user's Made by AI Playbook: Opus writes the script (1, 5, 8, 12 or 20 minutes) and one editorial image prompt per sentence, the image model paints each paper-collage illustration, the voice model narrates every sentence, Opus plans each image's paper-layer build and transition, and code animates it frame by frame (Lemo-Opuscar's renderer); narration and paper sound effects, no music.

execution.service_target: engines/vox_doc_engine.py (Lemo-Opuscar renderer, MIT, vendored in tools/opuscar)

source.license: MIT (code only; its CC BY-NC style docs are not used)

best_for: documentaries on history, business, countries, economics, technology, science, mysteries and society in the VOX / Johnny Harris editorial paper-collage look
1 to 20 minute narrated documentaries with no AI video cost
not_good_for: live action or photoreal motion (use Storyboard & Video)
explaining an uploaded document (use the Document Explainer)
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-18. Images from the image model (Nano Banana Pro on fal), narration through presenter_engine.speak (Kokoro locally, ElevenLabs when paid voices are on), the animation is a deterministic canvas page played by the vendored Lemo-Opuscar renderer; Opus (DOC_LLM_MODEL) writes the script, image prompts and layer plans.
